يستسهلون (form X)
# يَسْتَسْهِلُونَ (yastashilūna) /jas.tas.hi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
# يُسْتَسْهَلُونَ (yustashalūna) /jus.tas.ha.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
